children.innerHTML: Night Shift is a label that still believes in sides. Twelve songs, one lacquer, five hundred copies, no skip button. Scroll to spin the record.
Small roster, long contracts, no 360 deals. We sign people, not spreadsheets.
180-gram runs of five hundred, hand-numbered, mastered for vinyl first.
Our songs end up in films by directors who still buy records. Coincidence? No.
Fridays at eight, the office becomes a bar with one rule: whole sides only.
